title: 第14章 屠帮第15章 淬皮境
lines: 第14章屠帮
月色皎洁，鸟雀啼鸣。
屠宰场工作区烛光熄灭，显得格外安静。
管理处，楚生从椅子上瞬间站起身来，疑问道：“屠帮？”
“不错！”陈坤端坐着，充满诱惑地说道：“只要你愿意加入，赚的可不是铜钱，而是银子、金子了，甚至……还可以学到功法、武技！”
既可以赚取杀戮值，还能挣钱，甚至可以学到功法和武技。
这不完全是按楚生想要的来设计吗？
这杀手组织，不比武馆香？
楚生虽然心动，但还是问出了心中的疑惑：“陈师，这么好的福利，有什么条件吗？”
“沉着冷静，我果然没看错你！”陈坤手指点了点桌子，继续道：“不错，的确是有条件的！”
“首先是投名状，完成一次刺杀任务，任务对象由我指定。”
“其次便是实力，要求必须是武者，至少是淬皮境武者。”
“完成以上两个要求，你才有资格参与选拔，而且选拔，会有死亡的可能；但是，通过选拔的奖励，极其丰厚。”
余光瞥见楚生一脸严肃，陈坤坦然道：“事关生死，选择权在你。”
想到可能面临的生死危机，楚生问道：“陈师，你在屠帮又是扮演什么角色？”
“呵呵！任务失败，被淘汰的人，只能依靠屠夫行当讨生活的废人罢了！”陈坤眼底闪过一丝伤感，自嘲道，“我还算幸运的，至少能活到现在！”
“凭借当年学到的功法武技，也能在这乱世中有一处立足之地。”
“现如今，除了管理这屠宰场，还顺带发掘一些可造之才，输送到屠帮，赚取一些引荐的奖励。”
见到对方毫不遮掩，楚生便信了七八分。
但是，风险极大。
自己有系统面板，只要在屠宰场苟住，慢慢赚取杀戮值，未尝不可成长为一代强者。
但是，自己穿越十几年，就是为了苟活于世吗？
系统加身，不走一场波澜壮阔的人生，就白瞎杀戮系统了！
楚生越想越激动，就想冲动答应下来，但最终还是压制住了冲动，吐出声音道：“陈师，容我回家考虑一下。”
“不急，屠帮今年的选拔还有三个月时间，你回家好好考虑。”陈坤似乎对于楚生的反应早有预料，表现得极为平静，往后一靠。
楚生心脏砰砰直跳地离开屠宰场。
即便他经常杀生，也杀了不少人，看起来已经无所畏惧，但都是在自己可掌控的情况下进行的。
现如今，出现一条充满危机的、他无法掌控的通天大道，他犹豫了！
因为杀了王虎获得十两黄金，二十两白银，其实已经足够他去学武很长一段时间了。
可是，杀戮系统只有不断地杀，才能发挥逆天效果。
刻苦修炼，是行不通的！
当杀手，风险高，但收益也极大！
到家的时候，楚生都是懵懵的，心情格外沉重。
content_en:
Chapter 14 Massacre
The moon is bright and clear, and the birds are chirping.
The candlelight in the slaughterhouse work area was extinguished and it seemed particularly quiet.
In the management office, Chu Sheng instantly stood up from his chair and asked, "Tu Gang?"
"Not bad!" Chen Kun sat upright and said seductively: "As long as you are willing to join, you will earn not just copper coins, but silver and gold, and you can even... learn exercises and martial arts!"
You can earn kill points, make money, and even learn exercises and martial arts.
Isn't this exactly what Chu Sheng wants?
Is this killer organization no better than a martial arts school?
Although Chu Sheng was moved, he still asked the doubts in his heart: "Master Chen, are there any conditions for such a good benefit?"
"Calm down, I saw you right!" Chen Kun pointed at the table and continued: "Yes, there are indeed conditions!"
"The first step is to submit a certificate of honor and complete an assassination mission. The target of the mission will be designated by me."
"The second thing is strength. The requirement is that you must be a warrior, at least a warrior in the skin-tempering realm."
"Only by completing the above two requirements can you be qualified to participate in the selection. In addition, there is a possibility of death in the selection; however, the rewards for passing the selection are extremely generous."
Out of the corner of his eye, he caught a glimpse of Chu Sheng's serious face, and Chen Kun said calmly: "It's a matter of life and death, the choice is yours."
Thinking of the life and death crisis he might face, Chu Sheng asked: "Master Chen, what role do you play in the Tu Gang?"
"Haha! The mission failed, and those who were eliminated are useless people who can only rely on the butcher trade to make a living!" A trace of sadness flashed in Chen Kun's eyes, and he laughed at himself, "I am quite lucky, at least I can survive until now!"
"With the martial arts and martial arts I learned back then, I can still have a foothold in this troubled world."
"Nowadays, in addition to managing this slaughterhouse, I also discover some potential talents and send them to the slaughterhouse to earn some referral rewards."
Seeing that the other party was not hiding anything, Chu Sheng was convinced.
However, the risks are extremely high.
If you have your own system panel, as long as you survive in the slaughterhouse and slowly earn killing points, you might be able to grow into a powerful person.
But, did he travel through time for more than ten years just to survive?
The system is added to the system. If you don't lead a magnificent life, the system will be killed in vain!
The more Chu Sheng thought about it, the more excited he became, and he wanted to agree impulsively, but in the end he suppressed the impulse and said in a voice: "Master Chen, let me go home and think about it."
"There's no rush. There are still three months left for Tu Gang's selection this year. You should go home and think about it carefully." Chen Kun seemed to have anticipated Chu Sheng's reaction. He acted extremely calmly and leaned back.
"Yes!"
Chu Sheng left the slaughterhouse with his heart pounding.
Even though he often kills, he also kills many people. He seems to be fearless, but he does it under circumstances that are within his control.
Now, a dangerous avenue appeared that he could not control. He hesitated!
Because he got twelve taels of gold and twenty taels of silver from killing Wang Hu, which was actually enough for him to learn martial arts for a long time.
However, the killing system can only achieve its heaven-defying effect by killing continuously.
Practicing hard will not work!
Being a killer carries high risks, but the rewards are also huge!
When he got home, Chu Sheng was confused and in a particularly heavy mood.
